tasks.gr8-algebraic-expressions-t2: Topic: Algebraic expressions. Cover expanding, factorising, and simplifying expressions with accurate symbolic manipulation. Ask Grade 8 learners to manage brackets, signs, and like terms with clear reasoning.
tasks.gr8-algebraic-equations-t2: Topic: Algebraic equations. Cover solving linear equations, balancing operations, and checking solutions by substitution. Ask Grade 8 learners to isolate variables correctly and validate final answers.
tasks.gr8-construction-of-geometric-figures-t2: Topic: Construction of geometric figures. Cover accurate constructions of angles, triangles, and quadrilaterals using standard instruments. Ask Grade 8 learners to follow constraints precisely and interpret constructed properties.
tasks.gr8-geometry-of-2d-shapes-and-straight-l: Topic: Geometry of 2D shapes and straight lines. Cover polygon properties, angle relationships, and parallel-line reasoning. Ask Grade 8 learners to determine missing angles and justify statements with correct geometry facts.
